name: Jellyseerr
description: Let people request movies and shows for Jellyfin, Plex or Emby.
compose:
services:
  jellyseerr:
    image: fallenbagel/jellyseerr:latest
    container_name: jellyseerr
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:5055"
    environment:
      TZ: "{TZ}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/app/config
